The '''2022 Retro League''' was the first season of the [[Retro League]], the [[Players Committee]]'s league on [[GEMP]]. It was free and ran five events from February to October. More than 60 players from Australia, North America and Europe played at least one event, with an average of over 40 per event.<ref name="pc2023" /> [[Jared Napolitano]] was the tournament director, opening the season thread and the event threads; he also ran registration and prize support.<ref name="t80048" /><ref name="t80194" /> [[Steve Sanders]] sent the kick-off and pairings emails.<ref name="t80194" />

== Format ==
Each event was six games of Swiss, one game a week against an assigned opponent, scored by strength of schedule.<ref name="t80048" /> Games used 45-minute timers per side, and a player who timed out lost the game.<ref name="t80194" /> League points were 3 for a win and 1 for a loss, plus 4 for an event winner and 2 for the runner-up.<ref name="t80597" />
